phases.title: Python Foundations & Basics
phases.why: Establishes essential syntax, environment setup, and primitive data types to build a rock-solid foundation.

topics.title: Variables and Naming Conventions
topics.description: Understand variable allocation, scope basics, dynamic typing, and PEP8 naming conventions.
exercises: Swap two variables without temp variable

topics.title: Primitive Data Types (int, float, str, bool)
topics.description: Master core primitive types, immutability, memory behavior, and truthy/falsy evaluation.
exercises: Perform arithmetic with floats vs ints

topics.title: Operators (Arithmetic, Relational, Logical)
topics.description: Learn operator precedence, short-circuit evaluation, and binary logical operations.

topics.title: Type Casting and User Input
topics.description: Handle user input gracefully, convert strings to numerical types safely, and handle TypeErrors.
exercises: Build a simple age calculator using input()
Prompt user for numbers and return sum

topics.title: String Manipulation & F-Strings
topics.description: Master string formatting, slicing syntax, raw strings, and essential str methods.

phases.title: Control Flow & Decision Making
phases.why: Controls program execution branching, loop iterations, and structural pattern matching.

topics.title: If, Elif, and Else Statements
topics.description: Branch execution using conditional statements, ternary operators, and logical chaining.
exercises: Check if year is a leap year

topics.title: For Loops and the range() Function
topics.description: Iterate over collections, range sequences, and leverage enumerate() for index tracking.
exercises: Use enumerate() to print index and item

topics.title: While Loops
topics.description: Construct condition-driven loops, avoid infinite loops, and use loop control flags.

topics.title: Break, Continue, and Pass Statements
topics.description: Control loop execution flow, jump iterations, and place placeholder stubs.
exercises: Find prime numbers with loop break

topics.title: Match-Case (Python 3.10+)
topics.description: Implement structural pattern matching for clean branching logic.
exercises: Handle HTTP status codes with match-case
Destructure tuple pattern in match statement

phases.title: Functions & Variable Scope
phases.why: Enables code modularity, encapsulation, functional paradigms, and reusability.

topics.title: Defining and Calling Functions (def)
topics.description: Write reusable code blocks, specify parameters, and return computational outputs.

topics.title: Positional and Keyword Arguments
topics.description: Understand positional arguments, explicit keyword parameter binding, and kwarg ordering.
exercises: Create function with mixed positional & keyword args

topics.title: Default Parameters & Return Values
topics.description: Set sensible default parameters and avoid mutable default argument pitfalls.
exercises: Demonstrate mutable default argument bug with list
Fix bug using None default check

topics.title: Variable-Length Args (*args & **kwargs)
topics.description: Accept arbitrary numbers of positional and keyword arguments inside functions.

topics.title: Lambda Functions & Anonymous Functions
topics.description: Write concise single-line anonymous lambda functions for inline processing.
exercises: Sort list of tuples using lambda key
Use lambda with map() and filter()
Create inline calculator dictionary of lambdas

topics.title: Variable Scope (Local, Global, Nonlocal)
topics.description: Master LEGB (Local, Enclosing, Global, Built-in) scope rules and closure patterns.

phases.title: Data Structures & Collections
phases.why: Provides optimal storage and manipulation strategies for structured datasets.

topics.title: Lists (Indexing, Slicing, Methods)
topics.description: Manipulate dynamic arrays using indexing, slicing, sorting, appending, and pops.
exercises: Sort list of dicts by key

topics.title: Tuples (Immutability & Unpacking)
topics.description: Leverage immutable tuple sequences, unpacking patterns, and named tuples.

topics.title: Dictionaries (Keys, Values, Methods)
topics.description: Store key-value pairs, leverage hash maps, and master dict methods like get() and setdefault().

topics.title: Sets (Uniqueness & Set Operations)
topics.description: Perform set algebra (union, intersection, difference, symmetric difference) for uniqueness.

topics.title: List & Dictionary Comprehensions
topics.description: Write elegant, pythonic single-line comprehensions for data transformations.
exercises: Filter even squares with list comprehension
Invert dictionary keys/values via dict comprehension

phases.title: Modules, Packages & Virtual Environments
phases.why: Organizes code into maintainable modules and manages third-party package dependencies safely.

topics.title: Importing Standard Libraries (math, random, os)
topics.description: Utilize built-in modules to extend Python capability without third-party dependencies.

topics.title: Creating and Importing Custom Modules
topics.description: Split code into multiple files and import functionality via relative and absolute imports.
exercises: Create helper module and import in main.py
Use from module import function syntax

topics.title: Understanding __name__ == '__main__'
topics.description: Control module execution entry points when scripts are executed vs imported.
exercises: Import script without triggering main execution

topics.title: Package Management (pip)
topics.description: Install, update, lock, and manage external Python packages from PyPI.

topics.title: Virtual Environments (venv)
topics.description: Isolate project dependencies using standard venv tool to prevent global package pollution.

phases.title: Object-Oriented Programming (OOP)
phases.why: Encapsulates state and behavior into reusable class templates for complex application design.

topics.title: Classes and Objects
topics.description: Define custom classes, instantiate objects, and understand instance memory references.

topics.title: The __init__ Method & Self
topics.description: Initialize object state upon instantiation and bind instance context via self.

topics.title: Instance vs. Class Attributes
topics.description: Distinguish between instance-specific properties and shared class variables.
exercises: Track total object count via class attribute
Override class attribute on specific instance

topics.title: Inheritance and the super() Function
topics.description: Extend base class behavior using single and multiple inheritance patterns with super().
exercises: Create Student subclass derived from Person

topics.title: Polymorphism & Method Overriding
topics.description: Override parent methods to customize behavior across polymorphic object interface definitions.
exercises: Create Animal parent with speak() method
Override speak() in Dog and Cat subclasses
Iterate over polymorphic list calling speak()

topics.title: Encapsulation (Private & Protected Members)
topics.description: Protect internal state using single/double underscore conventions and @property decorators.

topics.title: Magic / Dunder Methods (__str__, __len__)
topics.description: Customize built-in Python behaviors by implementing special double-underscore methods.

phases.title: Advanced Python Concepts
phases.why: Unlocks advanced metaprogramming, lazy evaluation, type hinting, and custom context handling.

topics.title: Decorators and Higher-Order Functions
topics.description: Wrap functions dynamically to extend behavior without modifying source code.

topics.title: Generators & the yield Keyword
topics.description: Produce lazy evaluation iterators that stream memory-efficient sequence values on demand.
exercises: Compare generator memory usage vs list

topics.title: Iterables and Iterators (__iter__, __next__)
topics.description: Build custom iterable classes by adhering to Python's iterator protocol.

topics.title: Context Managers & the 'with' Statement
topics.description: Manage resource allocation and teardown cleanly using __enter__ and __exit__.

topics.title: Type Hinting (typing module)
topics.description: Annotate code with type hints to improve IDE autocomplete, linting, and codebase maintainability.
exercises: Add type hints to functions with Union and Optional
Use TypedDict for structured dictionary shapes
Run mypy type checker on code

phases.title: Error Handling & File I/O
phases.why: Handles runtime exceptions gracefully and processes disk files in text, CSV, and JSON formats.

topics.title: Exceptions & Tracebacks
topics.description: Understand Python exception hierarchy and interpret stack tracebacks accurately.

topics.title: Try, Except, Else, and Finally blocks
topics.description: Construct bulletproof error handling logic with cleanup blocks.
exercises: Execute else block only on error-free run
Use finally block for resource cleanup

topics.title: Raising Custom Exceptions
topics.description: Define custom exception classes inheriting from Exception to signal domain errors.
exercises: Raise custom exception upon validation failure

topics.title: Reading and Writing Text Files
topics.description: Perform file operations safely using open(), context managers, and read/write modes.
exercises: Read file line by line with with statement
Count word occurrences in text file

topics.title: Working with CSV and JSON Data
topics.description: Parse and serialize structured data formats using built-in csv and json modules.
exercises: Parse JSON string to dict and dump back to file
Read CSV into dict list via csv.DictReader
Export dictionary dataset to formatted JSON

phases.title: Async Python & Concurrency
phases.why: Executes concurrent and parallel operations efficiently using threads, processes, and async event loops.

topics.title: Understanding Concurrency vs. Parallelism
topics.description: Master CPU-bound vs IO-bound performance characteristics and Python's GIL implications.

topics.title: Threading basics (threading module)
topics.description: Spawn threads for IO-bound operations and prevent race conditions using locks.
exercises: Download multiple URLs concurrently with threading
Synchronize shared state access with threading.Lock()

topics.title: Multiprocessing basics
topics.description: Bypass GIL restrictions for CPU-heavy processing by spawning isolated worker processes.
exercises: Pass data between processes with Queue

topics.title: Asyncio: async and await keywords
topics.description: Write cooperative single-threaded asynchronous code using Python's asyncio event loop.
exercises: Run async event loop using asyncio.run()

topics.title: Creating & Gathering Async Tasks
topics.description: Schedule concurrent asynchronous tasks using asyncio.gather() and task objects.
exercises: Run 10 API requests concurrently via asyncio.gather()
Handle exception in gather() with return_exceptions=True

phases.title: Web & APIs (Ecosystem Setup)
phases.why: Connects Python applications to the modern web through HTTP requests, scrapers, APIs, and databases.

topics.title: Understanding HTTP (GET, POST, PUT, DELETE)
topics.description: Learn web protocol fundamentals, request headers, status codes, and HTTP verbs.
exercises: Map HTTP verbs to CRUD operations

topics.title: Using the 'requests' Library
topics.description: Make synchronous HTTP GET, POST, and PUT requests to third-party web APIs.
exercises: Fetch JSON data from JSONPlaceholder API
Send POST request with JSON payload

topics.title: Web Scraping with BeautifulSoup
topics.description: Extract target DOM elements from HTML pages using CSS selectors and BeautifulSoup4.
exercises: Scrape headline titles from news website
Extract links with specific CSS class
Export scraped data into JSON file

topics.title: Building a Basic API with FastAPI
topics.description: Construct high-performance, type-safe REST API endpoints with Pydantic validation and automatic docs.
exercises: Create FastAPI app with GET and POST endpoints
Validate request body using Pydantic BaseModel
Test API via automatic Swagger docs

topics.title: Connecting to a Database (SQLite / SQLAlchemy)
topics.description: Persist application data into SQLite relational databases using direct SQL queries or ORMs.
exercises: Create SQLite database with sqlite3 module
Use SQLAlchemy ORM model to query records

projects.title: CLI To-Do App
projects.description: Build a feature-packed command-line task manager with input validation, local JSON storage, and priority tags.
stretchGoals: Add task search & filter by status
Add priority tags and due date sorting

projects.title: Weather API Dashboard
projects.description: Fetch real-time weather metrics using OpenWeatherMap API with async requests and format output into a slick terminal readout.
stretchGoals: Cache API responses locally for 10 minutes

projects.title: Web Scraper (BeautifulSoup)
projects.description: Automate data extraction from web pages, parse HTML document trees, and export structured datasets into CSV/JSON files.
stretchGoals: Add User-Agent rotation & error retry logic

projects.title: REST API (FastAPI)
projects.description: Design and deploy a high-performance backend API with automatic Swagger docs, Pydantic data validation, and CRUD operations.
stretchGoals: Add JWT token authentication & password hashing
Connect SQLite database via SQLAlchemy ORM

projects.title: Full-Stack App (Python + React)
projects.description: Connect a Python FastAPI backend with a React & Tailwind frontend via CORS, implementing JWT auth and real-time state sync.
stretchGoals: Deploy backend to Render and frontend to Vercel
